reasons.plausibility: Including realistic defect and oxygen impurity effects in conductivity models is well-grounded in physics and aligns with known scattering mechanisms, making the hypothesis scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: Comparing measurements on well-characterized samples to both the new model and the baseline perfect-crystal predictions provides a clear and feasible path to falsification.
reasons.usefulness: Incorporating defect and impurity effects addresses a key gap in existing models, making the approach highly relevant and valuable for researchers studying real-world high-entropy alloys.
